request.subject_description: Exact source rabbit ninja: cream fur, ONE upright and ONE bent/folded ear, plum ninja jacket, dark pants, short red scarf, round tail, original waist gear and SHORT belt dagger. Preserve pixel identity, proportions, costume asymmetry and weapon hand.
request.initial_pose: Exact original north-west standing idle reference. Preserve one upright and one bent ear, the same short belt dagger and all original equipment.
request.action_description: ONE aerial downward DAGGER CHOP body-pose sequence. Keep fixed BACK THREE-QUARTER NORTH-WEST: the back of head and jacket stay toward camera orientation throughout; no spin or face turn. Begin source idle, crouch for takeoff. Then make an airborne tucked-leg pose while lifting the short dagger BESIDE THE HEAD with elbow bent. Cut the dagger arm VERTICALLY DOWNWARD once in front of the body toward the UPPER LEFT / LEFT of the image target side. Follow with a clear low bent-knee landing/recovery pose and return to exact source idle. The game adds the jump height, falling arc and landing translation: draw only the body's crouch/tuck/blade-lift/downstroke/landing poses around one fixed root on the sprite canvas. Do not translate the whole character up/down or across the canvas. Preserve one permanently bent ear and one upright ear at every angle, the same short dagger and hand, and source outfit. Blade length stays shorter than torso width; never a sword. BODY ONLY: transparent background, no slash trails, no particles, no flashes, no shockwaves, no duplicate bodies, no new equipment. Keep source pixel-art rendering and proportions.
